Your DeepSeek Harness on your own VPS — one command, reac"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"hable from anywhere, native UI intact"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"简体中文 · English"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **这是 DSH 的 VPS 部署工具：把带登录界面的原版 DSH 装到你自己的 VPS 上，之后在任何地方用浏览器访问。** 两种装法任选其一："},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**① 在自己电脑上的 DSH 里填表安装**：插件市场搜索 `dsh-vps` 安装（或执行 `dsh plugin add dsh-vps`），打开「设置 → VPS 部署」，填服务器 IP、SS"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"H 端口、用户名，选登录方式（密码 / 私钥 / 本机密钥），有域名再填域名，点「安装到这台 VPS」。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"**② 在 VPS 上执行一键安装命令**："},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"有域名、在国内网络时，在末尾追加参数，例如 `bash -s -- --domain dsh.example.com --mirror cn`，详见下方安装。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## 简介"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness（DSH）默认只认本机浏览器：它的特权接口（设置、API Key、插件管理）受浏览器信任围栏保护，直接反代到公网后这些页面全部失效。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"dsh-vps 用一个零运行时依赖的登录网关（dsh-gate）架在 DSH 前面：公网请求先过 scrypt 登录门，再由网关以服务端身份完成 DSH 会话认证并透传。你在任何地方打开浏览器，用的都"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"是官方原版的 DSH Web 界面，设置、模型、API Key、插件市场该有的都有。"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) trusts the operator's own browser only: its privileged interfaces — settings,"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" API keys, plugin management — sit behind a browser-trust fence, and a plain reverse proxy to the pu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"blic internet leaves those pages dead."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"dsh-vps puts a zero-dependency login gateway (dsh-gate) in front of DSH: public requests pass a scry"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"pt login gate first, then the gateway performs DSH session authentication server-side and proxies th"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"e rest. You open a browser anywhere and get the stock DSH web interface — settings, models, API keys"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" and the plugin marketplace all working."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## 能力一览"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| 能力 | 说明 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| 两种装法 | 在自己电脑上的 DSH 里填表、点一下安装（Mac / Windows / Linux）；或在 VPS 上执行一条 `curl \| bash`。装完即 systemd 托管、开机自"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"启 |
